blurb: This check records the Shared Ethernet Adapter thread attribute on a VIOS. IBM does not require thread=1. https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/ibm-virtual-io-server-download-support says thread=1 is the default after APAR IY62264 and thread=0 is a valid throughput choice (more consistent quality of service, lower LAN throughput). Either value passes. The check does not invent a required setting and never runs chdev. No SEA is not applicable.
